invariants.rationale: Context object is required for distributed spark-like engines, and all engine APIs would expect non-null context.
instantTime typically denotes the commit time as a required string, so it should not be null.
A null record list would not be processable and should be supplied as at least an empty list.
Option objects should not be null, but can represent absence via Option.empty().
If the records list is not empty, its first element should not be null, as null records cannot be processed.
